reason: User approved rerunning M02 with expanded models, Optuna, nested chronological CV and simultaneous overall/daily-maximum accuracy. Prior results are retained as historical development evidence.
secondary_target: target_mean will be checked with the selected configuration in the follow-up, without a second broad optimization
inner_rule: For each validation month, fit on all eligible rows strictly before that month. Calendar-month boundaries, not row-count TimeSeriesSplit, because invalid dates create gaps. No random train/test split. One-hour labels are observed before next-hour forecast origin; no overlapping future target window and no extra gap is imposed.
outer_rule: All tuning, ensemble member/weight selection occurs only inside each outer training period. Refit on all outer training rows, freeze for that evaluation month and update observed lag inputs hourly. This is sequential one-hour prediction, not month-ahead forecasting.

optuna.extension_rule: After 30 trials, extend to 50 only if best normalized minimax score improves at least 1 percent over best first 20 trials. No outer-dependent extension.
optuna.pruner: NopPruner; every candidate sees every inner month
optuna.objective: Two objectives: pooled inner overall MAE and date-balanced actual daily-maximum-hour MAE. Retain Pareto trials; select minimum max(relative overall MAE, relative peak MAE), normalized by inner previous-hour baseline.

ensembles.mean5: Equal average of five tuned families
ensembles.weighted_top3: Select top 3 single models by inner normalized minimax score; optimize two MAEs for 50 trials using cached inner OOF predictions. Freeze members/weights for outer month. This inner score is for selection and is not an independent performance estimate.
ensembles.stacking: Deferred: small set of independent development months and added meta-model selection complexity; first test simple and weighted averaging.

provisional_selection: Two primary MAEs are published separately. Retain nondominated outer-development methods, select minimum max(overall MAE / previous-hour overall MAE, peak MAE / previous-hour peak MAE). Within 1 percent of best score among nondominated methods prefer existing HGB, then single models, then equal and weighted ensembles. A retrospective development redesign, not an independent final-test claim. Under/over, RMSE, monthly, profile and transition errors are diagnostics. Normalization is a transparent compromise, not a measured economic cost.
M03_followup: If family or settings change from initial HGB A, freeze each outer split A-tuned configuration including ensemble weights and refit A/B and C_A/C_B without retuning. Preserve old M03. Secondary mean target uses the same settings without separate broad tuning.
prohibited: outer evaluation used for early stopping
rewriting prior M02/M03 results as if planned before observation
